scope: 80 exact historical relationship rows; old operators, endpoint scopes and author mappings compared with the previously inspected source and current parent components. Repeated endpoint text reused only when exact. Final repaired retention remains to be rechecked.

rows.review_disposition: Retire the generic Vendéan-army/Nantes context edge. Pages 256–257 connect western defeat and repression, but Carrier’s victims were not identical with the field army. Keep the military and civilian populations distinct in 60DA/B452.

The related clue supplies no precise additional mechanism between Montagnard pragmatism and surveillance. Preserve factional adaptation in 86D and the actual watch-committee functions in CC141/7A343 rather than equating them.

A membership edge is unnecessary if BBD’s qualified federalist category and 8944’s Marseilles coalition and chronology remain explicit. Do not treat the southern movements as one uniform organization.

Revenge for Year II is an explicit motive within 7549 on 291–293. Internalization is sound with local, personal and partly royalist motives distinguished rather than a single organized royalist programme.
Hoche’s conciliatory policy and the negotiated agreements can be internalized in 8B56 on 289–290. Preserve religious guarantees, concessions and their provisional success.
9446 can internalize Robespierre’s isolation and the dictatorship interpretation, provided it distinguishes fears and accusations from proof of personal dictatorship on 278–281.
8A64 can retain punitive hoarding policy responding to subsistence pressure. Preserve the dates and distinguish accusations of speculation from demonstrated causes of every shortage.

The assassination attempts and red-shirt execution intensified Robespierre’s suspicions on 277. Keep the actual episode and its political effect within 9446 without treating the alleged common plot as established fact.

CC141 can preserve Committee formation and the later emergency-government/constitutional-suspension sequence. Do not make the July constitution the cause of the April institution or collapse those phases.
8B56 must retain British expedition expectations as one reason the 1795 agreements were unstable. An unbound future-force node is unnecessary; the strategic expectation is substantive parent content.

The constitution’s role in legitimacy and containment on 244–246 is substantive. Retirement requires E57/467 explicitly to preserve that political use, not merely two adjacent subject labels or a claim of implemented constitutional government.
8A64 must distinguish lower post-Thermidor wage rates from later abolition. The broad coup/controls association may retire only with that change in 285 preserved.
Billaud’s committee membership and centralizing work can be retained as named access within 35DD/1EB/CC141. Do not confuse his role with Carnot’s or treat the entire early formation as his creation.

The contrast between Robespierre’s representative moral democracy and direct sansculotte action is real on 272–273. Retire the unbound endpoint only with explicit parent content and an answerable comparative task; check that task at final integration.
Lyons belongs in a qualified regional-revolt framework, with its own coalition and sequence. Retire a repetitive membership edge while preserving B783 and the BBD route.

CC141 can internalize centralization institutionalizing emergency government on 263–264. Preserve administrative hierarchy, executive supervision and limits of compliance, not only the name Revolutionary Government.
Enragés are a specific radical tendency, not a synonym for all sansculottes. Retire the vague related edge with programme, rivalry, suppression and the broader moral economy independently accessible.

The red-shirt execution is a concrete use of the Prairial regime. A separate procedure edge is dispensable if 9446 preserves the episode and F3A preserves the law; do not use the episode as proof of the fabricated conspiracy.
Carnot’s committee membership and military role can be internalized in 81DD/1EB. Preserve the recruitment and organizational work without attributing the Committee’s entire creation to him.

The generic constitutional/representative-legitimacy link can retire, but E57 must retain post-purge legitimation and 65D the coercion of representation. Ratification is not the same as implementation or unconstrained sovereignty.

A component edge can retire if A314 retains the Tribunal’s creation, remit and procedures and CC141 differentiates other emergency institutions. Institutional membership does not establish sole authorship of the system.

Delayed compliance prompted central scrutiny on 264. Retirement is conditional on 30CDC retaining investigation, recall and recalibration plus the explicit local consequences; do not erase the oversight mechanism as merely related context.
8A64 can internalize the General Maximum as a response to subsistence pressure on 249–251/269. Preserve nationwide design separately from uneven practical effectiveness.

Preserve Girondin opposition to economic coercion and the Montagnards’ initial agreement followed by reversal under Parisian dependence. A generic faction-label edge can retire once that policy change is explicit in 8A64/86D.
CC141 must explicitly retain watch committees and certificates within the reorganized local system on 263. A self-edge is unnecessary once institutions and retained functions are named.

Women’s price-setting action and food riots are concrete pressures on punitive policy. Internalization in 8A64 requires those agents and actions, not only general scarcity; compare the women’s subject for access.
488D can internalize the Indies scandal preceding the Indulgent purge. Preserve actual corruption evidence and the later use of association, without accepting every foreign-plot accusation.

The scandal supplied a political weapon against the Indulgents. Preserve that function within 488D and distinguish a pretext/association from proof that every accused participant committed the same act.

Reject the author’s accepted-cartographic-evidence rationale. Map 225 interiors are excluded under scope v3. Retain Marseilles and extent through eligible 229/241 prose in BBD/8944; 9DA supports only its literal caption.

The September mobilization joins wartime emergency, food distress and competing radical pressure. Retire the broad channels edge only with the specific subsistence-to-September relation and an answerable emergence task retained.
BBD can preserve the prose-based extent and strategic weight of federalism. Exclude map-interior support on 225; geographic claims must be grounded separately in 229/241 prose.

Danton’s support for September measures on 251 predates his later moderation. Preserve the paid-attendance/coercive role in 488D/B537; retirement must not make his later Indulgence erase his earlier position.
8A64 can internalize wage non-enforcement as a political limit. Page 265 requires the government’s dependence on popular support and distinction between wage rules and actual enforcement.
Louis XVII’s death preceded succession and Verona. 1D983 can internalize the chronology while preserving the distinct loss of constitutional-compromise hopes and the new claimant’s terms.
DFDC can retain Bonaparte’s tactical role in reconquest alongside occupation and repression. Do not make him sole commander of the whole operation or source of every subsequent reprisal.

9446 can internalize the Republic of Virtue’s moral premises. Preserve representative democracy, education/morality and coercive purification as distinguishable elements, not proof of an implemented harmonious society.

8A64 can preserve scarcity/depreciation and provisioning distress stimulating riots and price-setting. The relation is contributory and politically mediated, not an exclusive economic cause of every protest.

CC141 must retain the explicit justification distinguishing revolutionary from constitutional government on 264. It is an argument for emergency powers and suspended normal guarantees, not evidence that the 1793 constitution operated.

The July crisis explains Committee reconstitution/consolidation, not its April creation. Retire the overbroad responds_to edge only with those phases and the crisis response explicit in 1EB/CC141/0853.

BBD can internalize the federalists’ recruitment failure and social limits. Preserve the contrast between propertied leadership and reluctance to mobilize popular force; do not reduce all local defeats to one motive.

The old repression umbrella must not become a Marseilles/Bordeaux parent of Toulon. Retire the malformed includes edge; retain Toulon’s separate foreign-occupation and reconquest sequence and comparative repression access.
8A64 can retain nationwide controls responding to provisioning crisis. Preserve local enforcement and political limits on 264–265 as well as the legislative response.
Carnot’s implementation belongs within 81DD, but retain mass mobilization and administrative organization as distinct from a claim that he personally originated every levée measure.

Verona’s uncompromising terms closed a negotiated Bourbon option on 295–296. Preserve that political consequence inside 1D983 with the separate effect of Louis XVII’s death; an abstract unbound node is unnecessary.
The Enragés/sansculotte related edge can retire with their non-equivalence explicit and their programme, rivalry and suppression retained. The moral-economy comparison must remain answerable.

Lyons is a local case of anti-Jacobin backlash with specific property fears and coalitions. Retire the generic instance edge without turning the broader federalist movement into a uniform royalist response.

Republican command failures and later effective leadership matter to the Vendéan campaign on 247/256. Internalization in 60DA requires the reliability/competence distinction and changes over time, not only army identity.

Retire the mis-scoped army-as-location/population relation. AF783 must retain concentration of deaths in western rebellion areas, while 60DA distinguishes the field army from the broader civilian victims.
1D983 can internalize Louis XVII’s death preceding Louis XVIII’s declaration. Keep the precise succession and political consequences, not merely a biographical date.
Watch committees survived centralization. CC141 must preserve that continuity and their surveillance/certificate functions on 258/263; a self-edge is unnecessary.
Hoche’s conciliation responded to continued western insurgency. 8B56 must retain why defeat of the great army did not end rebellion and why guarantees/concessions were attempted.

Danton’s defense of associates is a named factional action. Retire the broad support edge only with that action retained in 488D/4E4, and distinguish actual financial misconduct from fabricated foreign-plot charges.

2319 correctly reverses accelerated_by: removal of controls and market procurement/revenue problems accelerated paper issues and collapse on 286–287. Preserve other causes and do not claim abolition alone caused depreciation.

60DA can internalize the emergence of Catholic and royal identity from the uprising. Preserve popular recruitment, religious conflict and later adoption of leadership rather than a wholly aristocratic original conspiracy.
Toulon’s motives and eventual royalist/foreign turn remain in DFDC and its qualified federalist-exception route. Retire the nonspecific related edge without universalizing the eventual alignment.

The war/internal-crisis umbrella is broader than CC141’s institution. Retire the projected context edge, preserving the actual military emergency and purge chronology in their own parents; do not call the purge a component of an administrative institution.
8B56 can internalize continued resistance provoked by repression and conscription on 288–289. Preserve those causes and religious grievances separately from later peace concessions.
Louis XVII’s death removed a specific constitutional Bourbon possibility. Internalization in 1D983 is sound only if that lost option is explicit and not merged with Verona’s later terms.
9446 can internalize democratic theory as a foundation of the Republic of Virtue. Preserve the kind of democracy and moral requirements, without substituting sansculotte direct participation.

Enragé involvement in May/June mobilization can remain in FEC/8E3. Retire the generic supports edge only with the actual participation/programme explicit and without implying control of the Convention afterward.
CC141 must retain delayed compliance and representative resistance as limits of centralization on 264. An internally consolidated subject must not become an assertion of immediate, uniform control.
The districts, communes and national agents are concrete components of CC141. Internalization is appropriate with hierarchy and responsibilities preserved.

CC141 can internalize the emergency justification, but the direct theoretical distinction is on 264; 252/263 alone support adjacent measures. Correct evidence scope and preserve constitutional suspension rather than implementation.
PROP-1711 preserves assignat collapse worsening hardship, alongside harvest, transport, weather and policy causes. Keep that qualified direction and the 1794–1795 temporal scope.
Lyons’s membership in regional resistance need not have a separate edge. Preserve city access, distinct social coalition and the qualified federalist category.

General Security’s handling of the Indies scandal is a named institutional role. Retirement requires the investigative/detention action retained in 488D/7A343 and must not validate the alleged foreign plot.

8A64 must retain the Subsistence Commission and Lindet’s role in distribution, enforcement and relative currency recovery on 265. Do not equate a controlled-economy label with these named administrative mechanisms.

The Montagnard policy reversal responded to scarcity and political dependence. Internalization requires the initial opposition as well as later adoption, not an impression of uninterrupted support for controls.

The broad contrast between Danton’s changing committee position and the constitution is underspecified. Retire it while preserving his removal, committee organization and ratification/suspension as separate, chronologically precise requirements.

Retire a universal federalist-opposition-to-emergency-government edge. Preserve local property fears, controls and institutional grievances with their timing; the source does not make every revolt opposition to the entire later system.

Punitive economic demands contributed to expanding emergency powers, but the broad endpoints erase measure and date. Retire only with specific hoarding penalties, coercive institutions and their chronology retained in 8A64/CC141.
60DA can retain destruction of the great army followed by devastation and infernal columns. Preserve the sequence and civilian effects; army defeat did not itself end resistance.
Toulon can be situated within the southern revolt without a repeated membership edge. Preserve its distinct later royalist/foreign alignment and the broader category’s limits.
The Enragés’ punitive economic programme should survive in FEC and 8A64. Retire the generic related link without making them identical to all controls advocates or all sansculottes.

The representatives’ emergency powers can be retained in named subjects and an explicit implementation relation. Retire the broad includes edge only with institutional date, remit and central-control limits preserved.
PROP-1711 correctly reverses worsened_by and retains depreciation as one aggravating factor. It does not replace the distinct harvest, winter, transport and policy explanations.

Town-country conflict must remain locally differentiated. In particular, Marseilles’s hinterland on 229 cannot be evidence for the Vendée; preserve that distinction in BBD/8944 and 60DA rather than a common-identity edge.
Toulon’s backlash can be retained in its local coalition narrative. Retire the umbrella instance edge without projecting its final royalism onto every federalist city.
8A64 can internalize economic distress contributing to Montagnard reversal, with political dependence and initial opposition explicit. A simple economy-causes-policy formula would be too strong.
8A64 can internalize the relationship between scarcity and punitive anti-hoarding policy. Preserve the distinction between actual scarcity, contemporary accusations and enforcement choices.
